nom: Neutrogena Stubborn Blackheads Daily Acne Facial Serum with Salicylic

segments.sensitive: The one reviewer with self-described sensitive, acne-prone skin, who also has very dry patches, reports no redness, irritation, burning or breakouts, though she hadn't yet seen improvement in blackheads at the point of her review.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report gradual improvement, including pores looking less dark, though not smaller, after about a month, and one long-time user says it's the only product that has kept her skin from feeling too oily without drying it out.
segments.dry: The one reviewer who also describes very dry patches on her sensitive, acne-prone skin reports no irritation or dryness from the serum.

concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report visible improvement in blackheads and other breakouts, in some cases within a single day, and a couple say it dries out hormonal or facial acne especially fast; a couple of reviewers hadn't seen results yet after a few weeks and were still waiting to judge.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers warn that using it more than once a day can dry out or peel the skin, and one reviewer needs to follow up with lotion or her face feels tight; against this, one long-time user reports it controls oiliness without drying her skin out at all.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no redness, irritation or burning, including one who avoided the redness that normally comes from squeezing blackheads by hand; against this, one critical reviewer had a severe reaction of puffiness, itching, redness and blotchiness starting from her very first use.
concerns.spots: A few reviewers, all describing acne-related discoloration, report the serum fading dark marks and post-acne marks alongside clearing active blemishes, generally with consistent day-and-night use over time.
concerns.oiliness: The one reviewer who addresses this specifically says it's the only product, after years of use, that keeps her skin from feeling too oily without drying it out.

aspects.libelle: Strong, unpleasant smell, described as fishy or medicinal
Small bottle, but the product goes a long way
Lightweight, thin, fast-absorbing texture with no residue
Warns against overuse; more than once daily can dry or peel skin
Requires consistent use over several weeks to see clear results

extraits.titre: Broke My Face Out With First Use. Adding An Extra Star Because It Does Help With Blackheads
extraits.texte: The purpose of my trying this was to see if I could get rid of stubborn blackheads on my nose and t-zone. It did great for the blackheads. No issue there. That part worked. Its the itchy red face that I cant deal with. The serum started making my face puffy, itchy, red and blotchy after the first use. It started swelling up right away. I couldn't stop scratching my face, which of course didn't make it any better. Even after washing my face with gentle cleanser, it still was very red. I have large pores but not bumps or acne. Bumps starting popping up, as my face grew itchier. This serum just isn't for me. My skin didn't like it at all. This is a dermatologist-grade acid complex also formulated with 5% glycolic acid. It could be too strong for my face.

extraits.titre: Smells terrible and doesn’t do much
extraits.texte: It works but not to warrant the price and little amount you get. It’s not really anything great in fact I’ve seen much better products with a better smell. It smells like a fish kept in a plastic bag for six months I don’t know why they couldn’t cover it up better. Didn’t irritate my skin thankfully.

extraits.titre: Interesting spout, will update with longer term frequent use.
extraits.texte: * I am in my early 30s with sensitive acne-prone skin with very very dry patches. I have some acne scars, discoloration and quite a bit of sebaceous filaments. Description of Product: - Name: Neutrogena Stubborn Blackheads Daily Acne Facial Serum with Salicylic, Glycolic, Polyhydroxy & Mandelic Acids, Oil-Free Face Serum for Acne-Prone Skin to Help Clear Clogged Pores, 1 fl. oz - Color, Texture and Scent: This is a slightly milky white, serum that is slightly runny. It is fragrance-free, though it does have a slight scent of the ingredients that goes away pretty quickly. - Other Characteristics: It has a super interesting looking spout that reminds me of a dropper. My Impression: - When Applied: It applies easily and gets absorbed / dries pretty quickly without leaving a residue - Afterwards: I have not experienced any redness, irritation, burning or breakouts after using this product. Conclusion: - Overall? It suggests usage up to 3 times a day, which I haven't done so yet - maybe this is why I haven't really seen any improvements in blackheads / pore size or sebaceous filaments but I'll continue using this to see if it helps. It also warns of drying or peeling of skin, which I haven't experienced so far. I'll update the review with further longer-term use.

extraits.titre: Seems to be making a difference after 1 month
extraits.texte: I've used many products that claim to treat blackheads. I have oily skin and large pores, and even though I scrub and treat, nothing seemed to make any improvement. I've been using this product for about a month on my nose and chin, and I'm starting to see results. My pores don't necessarily look smaller, but they are definitely not as dark. So I'm encouraged after trying so many things that didn't work, even other products from Neutrogena. I will keep using and I'll update this review after another month or so.

extraits.titre: Great stuff works quickly, but don’t overuse
extraits.texte: This is a salicylic acid gel in a small tube. You apply it to pimples and they go away in a day or so. Do not over use it as your skin will dry out and may peel. I wouldn’t use more than once a day. Also has a warning about sun burn with use. Otherwise it works well in moderation.

extraits.titre: Es una maravilla este producto se ven los cambiosEs una maravilla este producto se ven los cambios
extraits.texte: Hola a todos aqui dejo mi opinión acerca de este producto para mi es uno de los que mas me ayudado en el tema de acne este es mi segundo bote que estoy utilizando yo lo conocí por mi hermna ella me regalo el primero y me ayudo mucho no me enrito y la otra que vi cambios en el tono de mi piel aparte que me ayudo a disminuir me aclaro las manchas y aqui les dejo una foto del antes y el después. Para ver resultados hay que ser muy constante yo la uso de dia y de noche.

Llevo años usando este producto y hasta ahora ha sido el único que me funciona para que la piel no esté tan grasosa pero sin secarla. El olor puede ser un poco extraño al inicio pero después de un minuto realmente ya no se nota.
